Hey, Json GoGosqueezze, you might know me for my AYS's that I've made, well I'm going to give you a rundown on how the camera engine I use works.

CHARECTER PLACMENT 

In the Opponent/ Scratch and Player/Bf Sprites there should see 3 variables that say X Y and Size, those are going to be the placement of the character on screen, change those variable numbers to change the placement of the character.


CAMERA MOVMENT

In the camera handler sprite, there is a custom block that has two of the same custom blocks in the if=then category, they each say something like 130 -2 8 and the other says the same thing but with some different numbers. Thats the X Y and Zoom which is Z

 x 130 Y -2 Z/zoom -8

you have to change these depending on the height and placement of the character in the character stats. which is located in the character sprites.

OFFSETS

Do NOT edit the offsets in the offset handler unless you don't want camera movement. If you don't. Then set every custom block to 0 0 8.

MUSTHIT SECTIONS

In order for the characters to switch between the different character angles then you have to convert a chart JSON, you grab the chart JSON from the mod and then use the camera converter supplied by Spidey to then make it so the characters will switch back and forth between the cameras. The camera list is located in the same variable list that the chart list is found.
